top_signals.title: Washington's Iran Strategy Risks Strengthening Its Biggest Rivals
top_signals.summary: A renewed US-Israeli attack on Iran will bring economic disruption, security risks, and geopolitical realignment across Central Asia. The five republics would prefer to avoid involvement, but geography limits their ability to insulate themselves from the conflict. Iran is an important potential outlet to the Persian Gulf, the Indian Ocean, and wider markets. The consequences depend on the duration of fighting, Iranian retaliation, and whether Tehran retains control.  Iran offers a southern alternative to routes through Russia and the Caspian…
